purpose: Provenance for the 5-repeat GCP replication of grid_v6. raw.json cannot carry the image digest, trace hashes, stage-entry SHA or the host, so they are recorded here.
relation_to_grid_v6: Same image digest, same ChampSim revision, same three traces by SHA-256, same three candidates, same instruction budget. Only n_repeat changed, 2 to 5, and the physical host changed from a local Docker daemon to GCP.

resource_caps.cpu: no quota; OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 forced because Ray injects 1 and coreutils nproc obeys it, which silently made the build make -j1
resource_caps.shm: default 64 MiB (not raised for this run; the later screening container uses --shm-size=6g)

code_identity.note: run_grid_gcp.sh writes .tmp/grid_git_sha at stage entry, which is the defect grid_v6 recorded (raw.json only carries HEAD at write time).

trace_transfer_check: All three SHA-256 recomputed on the GCP host after upload and equal to the grid_v6 provenance values byte for byte.

results.relation: cycles, ipc and instructions are identical to grid_v6 on all 9 cells. What N=5 adds is that 45 runs across 9 cells show no spread at all, which grid_v6 explicitly declined to claim at N=2.

binary_identity.reading: The same source, image digest and ChampSim revision produced byte-different binaries on the second host while the simulated measurements stayed bit-identical. A binary digest is therefore evidence that a distinct build was delivered, not a design identity, and requiring digest equality across hosts would reject a faithful replication.

evidence_checker.reading: The checker still fails, but on a real property rather than a missing field: seed 2 is a per-trace nullity on imagick. Its cell-level rule reports this alongside genuine cross-trace differences, which is the conflation recorded in the grid_v6 provenance and still unfixed.

not_retained: ChampSim stdout for grid cells; cycles come from the --json stats file the adapter parses
artifact_notes.correction: An earlier draft of this file claimed raw.json carried no per-cell binary digest. It does: check_grid_evidence.py reads three distinct digests from it, verified above.
artifact_notes.prompt_axis: prompt spread 0.0000% is not a measurement. The grid holds a single prompt value, so the prompt axis was never exercised. The 3x3 prompt-by-seed factorial is the run that addresses it.
